Build order playbook

1 · Secure power first. Add generation and a 20–30% reserve before connecting the new line.
2 · Build backward. Place the final-product machines first, then work toward raw inputs. This exposes belt and floor-space requirements early.
3 · Separate logistics layers. Keep input manifolds, outputs, and utilities on consistent levels. Leave at least one foundation between major lines.
4 · Commission one stage at a time. Fill and test upstream machines before starting downstream production. Watch for belt saturation and fluid head-lift issues.
5 · Label everything. Mark item, rate, source, and destination at every inter-factory connection. Future-you is another engineer.
6 · Sink overflow. Smart-split excess output to an AWESOME Sink so a backed-up final product does not stall useful byproducts.
